task.title: Remove a person
task.shortdesc: Remove a person from your tree, for example one you added by mistake.

prereq.p: Open the person first. shows how.

context.p: Use this only for a person who should not be in the tree, such as someone you added twice. To fix a wrong name, date or place, use instead.

step.cmd: Check the name in the trail at the top of the page.

info.p: This is the person who will be removed. The question you are asked also names them.

step.cmd: Scroll to the foot of the page and choose .

stepresult.p: A box titled opens. For Anne Brontë it asks Delete Anne Brontë? They will be removed and unlinked from any families, events and relationships. This cannot be undone. A line under it says what else changes, such as Also affects: 1 family, 2 events.

step.cmd: Read the question. Choose to remove the person, or to keep them.

result.p: The app says that removing a person cannot be undone. It also takes them out of their families and events.
result.note: Treat this as final. To be safe, save a copy of your tree first.
